big_case.notes: A private section 1983 suit over an off-duty deputy's fatal drunk-driving crash, resolved below on the clearly-established prong of qualified immunity in a published, divided Eleventh Circuit opinion asserting tension with the Tenth and Fourth Circuits. The accountability theme has some public resonance, but the vehicle is interlocutory, fact-bound, unresolved on color of law, drew no amici or government interest, and was denied silently at its first conference. Modest stakes.
